info.title: PortPulse AI API
info.description: PortPulse AI: forecasting, anomalies, CP-SAT optimisation, routing, and IBM Bob agent orchestration.

get.description:
W3: tidal depth curve for every berth (read-only).

Serves whatever the tide pipeline last persisted — NOAA CO-OPS rows when present,
else the labelled harmonic model — as depth_ft at each integer hour 0..hours per
berth. A GET never fetches or writes: the write side lives at startup (main.py)
and POST /api/tides/refresh.

post.description:
Force a fresh NOAA CO-OPS fetch and replace tidal window rows.

Returns {source, rows_written, station} — callable from the QualityPage refresh button.
W3 extended what-if: forecast and optimise the modified context, then compare.

get.description: Return the latest persisted plan or build a fresh engine-grounded plan.

patch.description: Module A: increment config_version so context fingerprint changes and caches invalidate.

post.description:
Import a physically complete vessel schedule and immediately rebuild the plan.

Physical fields are mandatory. The endpoint never substitutes fabricated vessel
dimensions, draft, moves or destination values.
Explicit normalisation + completeness recompute (the write side of Module D).

get.description:
Read the last computed per-terminal data-completeness snapshot (Module D).

Read-only by design (spec: GETs must be idempotent; B-5): normalisation runs
explicitly at startup or via POST /api/quality/refresh, never on this path.

post.description:
Run the W1 Open-Meteo pipeline and persist `WeatherObservation` rows.

Audit B-6: the pipeline existed but was never invoked, so `FEATURE_WEATHER` was
unreachable and `weather_used` stayed false forever. This is the missing wiring.
If Open-Meteo is unreachable the pipeline inserts nothing and this returns an
empty series — the forecast then reports `weather_used: false` instead of failing.

get.description: Wind/wave/visibility series for San Pedro Bay (rows persisted by the pipeline).

post.description:
Audit B-7: wire the BTS PPFSP benchmark parser to an endpoint (was dead code).

Accepts a BTS weekly-berthing CSV, validates and parses it, returning the rows
for forecast validation. Keeps the benchmark load-bearing.
Import a real NOAA AccessAIS CSV, aggregate it, and retain filtered track points.
Generate synthetic DEMO_AIS data for an offline/reproducible demo.
